narrative.overview: Safar is a cinematic listening surface in which the interface remains calm and fixed while the road environment changes around it. The visual world comes from midnight asphalt, brass ornament, cream sign-painting, Pakistani truck detail, and the glow of a long journey after dusk.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed road atmosphere with one stationary interface.
Brass is rare, directional, and meaningful.
Large Urdu identity; small editorial English labels.
One integrated smoked player surface, not a family of cards.
Motion is slow, environmental, and reduced-motion safe.

rules.name: The Brass Rarity Rule
rules.body: Brass marks identity, active state, progress, and direction; it never becomes a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Expressive Urdu leads; English supports through clean small-scale typography and never competes at display size.

rules.name: The One-Surface Rule
rules.body: The player may float; route items, journey metrics, and identity remain typographic and unboxed.

dos: Do preserve the stationary interface while the environment changes.
Do keep the YouTube player visible, unobscured, and at least 200×200.
Do maintain 44px touch targets and visible focus rings.
donts: Don't add generic music-app navigation or card grids.
Don't change the environment when a track changes.
Don't hide, mask, or place controls over the YouTube iframe.
